statement:
PROVISIONAL (machine-made from the Lean declaration; stage 1 writes it in words): Koszul and finite-quotient completion are canonically identified, preserving the units; their common functor is the reflector for the local internal-Hom completeness condition. Source: Stacks 099L, 099M, 0A0E (blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence). Proof: apply the ringed Koszul reflector to the global generators, including the empty list. For constant coefficients the Noetherian Koszul augmentation has pro-zero cone. Exact constant sheafification and tensor by a fixed K-flat model preserve this property. The strict-tower derived-limit theorem inverts the augmentation and identifies its unit with the quotient unit. For completed coefficients, restrict to constant coefficients: the finite reductions, strict Koszul tensors and units agree, and restriction identifies total derived limits by the flat exact adjunction on strict towers. Conservativity of exact restriction detects the augmentation isomorphism over the completion as well. Transport the reflector property and the unit-isomorphism criterion across this unit-preserving natural isomorphism.

```lean
theorem koszul_quotient_reflector [IsNoetherianRing A] (b : Bool) (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = I) :
    ∃ K : KoszulPresentation J A I b r a,
      (∃ e : koszulCompletion J A I K ≅ completion J A I b,
        ∀ M : D (coefficients J A I b), koszulUnit J A I K M ≫ e.hom.app M =
          (completionUnit J A I b).app M) ∧
      (∀ M : D (coefficients J A I b),
        IsComplete (finiteMap J A I b 0) ((completion J A I b).obj M)) ∧
      (∀ (M L : D (coefficients J A I b)), IsComplete (finiteMap J A I b 0) L →
        Function.Bijective (fun f : (completion J A I b).obj M ⟶ L ↦
          (completionUnit J A I b).app M ≫ f)) ∧
      (∀ M : D (coefficients J A I b),
        IsIso ((completionUnit J A I b).app M) ↔ IsComplete (finiteMap J A I b 0) M)
```
